meta.name: ImMATURE
meta.description:
A coming-of-age story about the many first adventures in a young man's life. Dhruv is 16, and in a hurry to grow up. With a little help from his school friends, the wannabe bad-boy Kabir, and the color-blind but doesn't know it Susu, Dhruv sets out to woo the first crush of his life, the feisty, out-of-his-league class topper, Chhavi. Venturing out of their childhood, in their last years of school, the trio find their first drink, pick their first fight and mend their first broken hearts.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 20 Feb 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: The Viral Fever, Contagious Online Media Network · Network: Prime Video

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 1/5 (missing E2-5) | S3 5/5

videos.title: Daddy's Little Princess
videos.overview: Having newly entered the 11th standard, Dhruv expects a new bullet bike from his parents. However, the gift that his parents get him, is neither new nor is it a bullet. Will Dhruv be able to break the ice and get close to Chhavi.

videos.title: Being HUMAyuN
videos.overview: Only to spend time with Chhavi, Dhruv participates in the Annual Day drama. He even makes Ranjan exit the play and lands a role opposite Chhavi, but things don't go as per his plan.

videos.title: Pehla Pehla Pyaar, Pehla Pehla Bar
videos.overview: Kabir suggests Dhruv to drink some alcohol to cope up with his heartbreak. After getting drunk, Dhruv gathers the guts to beat up Shantanu but after reaching his house he encounters an unexpected scenario.

videos.title: Unstable Equilibrium
videos.overview: After getting warned by the vice-principal, Dhruv, Susu and Kabir get serious about studies. Chhavi offers to help them and the group sessions bring her and Dhruv closer.

videos.title: Triple H Versus The Rock
videos.overview: Dhruv and Chhavi are both excited for the date. Kabir asks Dhruv to ensure that the date is great, while Nandini warns Chhavi against taking the relationship further.

videos.title: Time for a Change
videos.overview: Dhruv tries desperately to maintain his long distance relationship with Chhavi while Kabir and Susu feel ignored and start to search for Dhruv's replacement.

videos.title: It’s Complicated
videos.overview: Kabir and Susu’s friendship has been soured by Nandini taking a romantic interest in Susu. Kaavya tells Chhaya that she has been friend-zoned by Dhruv.

videos.title: All is Fair
videos.overview: Kaavya gives Chhaya tips to get out of the friend zone. Chhaya uses Lalit to make Dhruv jealous. Lalit warns Dhruv to stay away from Chhaya. Dhruv, Kabir and Susu fight with Lalit and his gang.

videos.title: Rumours
videos.overview: School buzzes with gossip about Dhruv’s fight with Lalit for Chhaya. Dhruv is trying to understand why Chhaya is upset with him. Kabir and Susu help out Dhruv to figure out the reason.

videos.title: Week of Love
videos.overview: It’s valentine’s week. Susu shares with Dhruv and Kabir that he wants to break up with Nandini. Dhruv receives gifts from a secret admirer. Dhruv takes Nandini’s help to find this secret admirer.

videos.title: Is this how it ends?
videos.overview: Class 11th has to plan a farewell for their seniors. Dhruv and Chhaya are annoyed to be paired in the same group. Someone ruins the gifts made by Chhaya. Kaavya confesses her love for Susu.
